title: Schedule
body:
**2:00** Bounce house opens
**3:00** Pizza
**3:45** Cake and presents
**4:30** Pick up

title: What to bring
body:
- Sneakers or socks for the bounce house
- A water bottle with your name on it
- No gifts needed - just come play!

title: Mission briefing
body:
**5:00** Landing party arrives
**5:30** Crater crafts and the saucer piñata
**6:30** Cosmic cupcakes
**7:30** Beam-up (pick up)

title: Dress code
body:
Costumes from any galaxy are welcome:
- Little green antennae (we'll have spares)
- Silver, glow-in-the-dark or anything shiny
- Astronaut, alien, or both at once

Comfy shoes - the desert gets dusty.

title: What to bring
body:
- A flashlight for the night-sky walk
- A jacket - it gets cold after sunset
- An empty jar for your moon rocks
- No gifts, please - just bring your best alien wave

title: Finding the landing site
body:
Follow the glowing saucers from the end of Mirada Road. Park along the street and walk up the lit path to the backyard.

Running late? Text the Mothership Crew and we'll hold the beam.
